Inspired by original May1988 Japanese Suzuki Escudo E-TA01W three-door HARDTOP, first generation narrow body, not later five-door Nomade. Very short upright three-door compact 4x4 SUV, boxy rectangular headlights, simple narrow horizontal grille, black plastic bumpers with modest amber indicators, pronounced original rounded blister fenders, square upright cabin with huge single rear side window each side, tiny rear overhang, tailgate with unbranded covered spare tire, narrow vertically rectangular tail lights. Weathered muted olive-green body, faded sand-beige roof, patched dark red front fenders, restrained rust and copper repair stitches. Standard-height original suspension and small15inch tire proportions, no lift kit, no roof rack, no external accessories. All road wheels and tires ABSENT with transparent wheel openings for shared animated tires; covered spare remains. No logos badges text numbers plates decals. No ground shadows or scenery. Same car exact eight orientations: top row FRONT straight; FRONT LEFT quarter noseRIGHT; LEFT PROFILE noseRIGHT; REAR LEFT quarter noseRIGHT. Bottom row REAR straight; REAR RIGHT quarter noseLEFT; RIGHT PROFILE noseLEFT; FRONT RIGHT quarter noseLEFT. Full bumpers visible, generous gutters, consistent scale and perspective. Original detailed painterly photoreal game art.
